name: Omarcat
author: Andy Wei
description: System monitor for the Omarchy bar with a cat that runs faster the busier the CPU is: an overview of CPU, memory, disk, battery and network at a glance, plus per-subsystem pages with live graphs.

barWidget.description: A cat in the bar that runs faster the busier the CPU is, and an iStat Menus-style panel behind it: an overview of the whole machine at a glance, plus pages for the processor, memory, disks and network.

schema.label: Runner
schema.description: Which animal runs in the bar.

schema.label: History (seconds)
schema.description: How far back the graphs reach.

schema.label: Look up public IP
schema.description: Ask api.ipify.org for your public address while the Network page is open. Off by default: it is an outbound request that reveals this machine's address to a third party.

schema.label: Top processes
schema.description: List the busiest processes on every page.
